name: [🎄] Skiing And Slide
desc:
❄️ Slide down the snowy mountains to earn money! 
💰 Use your cash to buy and try different boards! 
🐾 Hatch pets and upgrade them for more boosts!

⚡ Out of energy? Refill it in the shop!
🏆 Reach the top to earn trophies and unlock new trails! 
🌍 Collect enough trophies to explore new worlds! 
🎄 A brand-new Christmas world is coming soon - get ready for Santa's gifts!
✨ Enjoy your skiing adventure and have fun sliding!
